articles.title: CCI closes real money games-related case against Google
articles.summary: In 2022, Winzo Games Pvt Ltd filed a complaint against Google alleging restrictions for Real Money Games (RMG) on Google Play and about advertisement policy, among others. The Competition Commission of India (CCI) in 2024 ordered a detailed probe into the matter. Google made a commitment offering to address the anti-competition concerns, and the Online Gaming Act came into force from May 2026.

articles.title: EU-India FTA: European Commission sends landmark trade deal to council for signature, paving way for ratification
articles.summary: The European Commission has asked EU member states for approval to sign and conclude its landmark Free Trade Agreement with India, a deal that would eliminate or reduce tariffs on 96% of EU goods exports and save exporters an estimated €4 billion a year. Once cleared by the Council, the pact still needs European Parliament consent and India's own ratification before it can enter into force.

articles.title: Sebi proposes new CAS framework, two options for expiry-day settlement
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is set to implement crucial updates to the Closing Auction Session. A focus of these changes is on the process of derivatives settlement on expiry days. SEBI has laid out two alternatives for determining the derivatives settlement price: the first proposes a blended VWAP approach after one year, while the second keeps the current CTS VWAP process in place for the present.

articles.title: 10-year bond yield crosses 7% as RBI trims auction bids
articles.summary: On Friday, benchmark government bond yields climbed by five basis points, surpassing the 7% threshold. The Reserve Bank of India managed to accept less than half of the amount it had targeted in a three-year bond auction. Factors such as high global risk-free rates and escalating crude oil prices are exerting pressure on Indian bonds.

articles.title: Gem, jewellery exports rise 3.14% to $2.30 bn in August despite weak demand
articles.summary: India's gem and jewellery exports grew in August, with studded gold jewellery exports surging significantly. articles.title: Explained: What Sebi’s proposed CAS changes mean for expiry-day trading and settlement
articles.summary: The regulator has proposed two options for determining expiry-day settlement prices for index and stock derivatives, changes to the timing of the continuous trading session (CTS), CAS and derivatives trading, and additional measures aimed at improving the functioning of the auction.

articles.title: Demat 2.0 explained: Why it matters for bond market investors
articles.summary: In an innovative move, Sebi has rolled out Demat 2.0, a pilot scheme aimed at tokenising corporate bonds. This initiative facilitates rapid settlement and instant fund retrieval for investors. It automates interest and redemption payments through smart contracts, while atomic settlement mitigates risks by coordinating the release of bonds and payments seamlessly. Future developments will broaden this system's reach to secondary markets and individual investors.

articles.title: What Is a Tokenised Bond? How India's first blockchain bond will actually work and why it matters
articles.summary: India's capital markets have taken a significant step toward blockchain-based finance. State-owned REC Ltd. has raised ₹500 crore through India's first tokenised corporate bond issue. The issue received subscriptions for over 8 times the issue size. It's a landmark moment in the ongoing efforts to make India's bond market faster, cheaper, and deeper.
